rationale: The approved hierarchy proposal remains sha256:05a1b38d6bb758ed75e716f1aca956f79718edb1a39db51e99c435596d17a9b3. Three parents and fourteen logical children have concrete behavioral or engineering homes; detailed stable models remain delegated owners rather than new placeholder files. Individual skill invocation remains possible without CLI, while current governed recording and the selected CLI installation method require it.

Skill capability contracts define input/output, failure and handoff behavior. Engineering Development specifies repository development and integrated proof for both published outputs while Skill Assessment retains shared independent judgment policy. Explicit retained proposal and plan/boundary links now make the unmigrated specialist ownership directly discoverable.

Validation preserves TEST-SR-01–14 and adds independent case execution, explicit isolation, bounded shared scheduling, failure/timeout/descendant cleanup, no persistent cache and reader-based required cleanup. Conservative serial execution where independence is unknown is a safe compatibility boundary, not a substitute for the selected independent-case work. No runtime safety or measured performance result is inferred from Design.

Read both example indexes, correction-cycle diagram and directly relevant v3 finding correction descriptions/request/stored pair/full response. Exact request values transform only the stated finding fields and reproduce the updated record; full response equals that finding. These samples directly corroborate the corrected finding/blocker boundary. Other unchanged examples retain unchanged parent serialization/dispatch scope; this hierarchy change does not reinterpret them or assert their execution.

Release keeps separately authorized candidate publication and observed public proof; Design approval does not publish, install, adopt governance or approve executable implementation. Preserved original requirement IDs, exact displacement maps and current consumers support feasible downstream allocation without moving historical judgments. Old source/script/cache cleanup deferred to implementation remains required work, not silently completed by Markdown deletion.

All three first-pass findings have independently supported resolution. Broader source reading and first-pass concerns were retained through this reassessment; no additional material Design defect remains. Author structural/prose/link evidence supports document integrity only. Old failed legacy prose evidence and historical subject-drift observations retain their original scope and do not contradict this current Design judgment.
